MICROCOM · Odoo Integration Help

Official API base URL: https://zeus.microcom.es:4040/api/v1

Type: REST API with AES-256-CBC encryption

1) Authentication

MICROCOM Zeus API uses encrypted password authentication with AES-256-CBC cipher.

Required connection_params (JSON):

{
  "user": "base64_encoded_username",
  "password": "plain_text_password",
  "authPass": "base64_encoded_aes_key"
}

Parameters:

  • user: Username encoded in Base64 (may be URL-encoded)
  • password: Plain text password (encrypted at runtime with AES-256-CBC)
  • authPass: Base64-encoded 256-bit AES encryption key (32 bytes)

Authentication flow:

  1. Generate random 16-byte IV
  2. Encrypt password with AES-256-CBC using authPass as key
  3. Concatenate IV + encrypted password (both Base64 encoded)
  4. URL-encode the result
  5. Call: GET /accounts/{user}?authentication={encrypted_password}
  6. Receive Bearer token for subsequent requests

2) Response Decryption

All API responses are encrypted and compressed using a multi-layer format:

Decryption process:

  1. Extract IV (first 24 Base64 characters = 16 bytes)
  2. Extract ciphertext (remaining Base64 string)
  3. Decode both from Base64
  4. Decrypt with AES-256-CBC using authPass key and extracted IV
  5. Remove PKCS7 padding
  6. Decompress with gzip
  7. If result starts with "H4sI", decode Base64 again and decompress (double gzip)
  8. Parse JSON

3) Device & Sensor Configuration

Uses standard Odoo models:

  • Device: mdm.measurement.device
  • Sensor: mdm.measurement.device.sensor

Device remotecontrol_params (JSON):

{
  "station_id": "0UZ4DPQS",
  "start_date": "2026-02-01"
}

Parameters:

  • station_id: MICROCOM station identifier
  • start_date: (optional) Initial sync date (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS)

Sensor remotecontrol_params (JSON):

{
  "channel_id": 0
}

Parameters:

  • channel_id: Channel index (0-based) matching station configuration
  • start_date: (optional) Initial sync date, overrides device start_date

4) Available Procedures

A) Daily Sync (Scheduled)

Synchronizes readings from configured devices/sensors:

  1. Get Token - Authenticates and obtains Bearer token
  2. Build Sensor Plan - Loads configured sensors with start dates
  3. Get Readings and Upsert - Fetches historical data and stores readings

B) Get Devices (One-time setup)

Discovers station configuration for bulk device/sensor setup:

  1. Get Token - Authenticates
  2. Get Station Configuration - Queries all stations and generates JSON with:
    • Station ID
    • Model and Serial number
    • Channels list with: channel_id, name, unit

Generated JSON file is attached to the Remote Control record for manual device/sensor creation.

5) API Endpoints Used

Authentication:

GET /accounts/{user}?authentication={encrypted_password}

Historical data:

GET /historical/{station_id}?Accept-Encoding=gzip&startDate={dd-mm-yyyy;HH:MM:SS}&endDate={dd-mm-yyyy;HH:MM:SS}&channelView=CUSTOM&channels={channel_id}

Station discovery:

GET /stations?status=all&Accept-Encoding=gzip

Station properties:

GET /stations/{station_id}/properties?Accept-Encoding=gzip

6) Date Format Conversion

MICROCOM uses non-standard date format:

  • API format: dd-mm-yyyy;HH:MM:SS (semicolon separator)
  • Odoo format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS

The integration automatically converts between formats in both directions.

7) Required Headers

All authenticated requests must include:

  • User-Agent: ZeusClient ApiREST
  • Date: {RFC-1123 format} - e.g., "Mon, 03 Feb 2026 14:30:00 GMT"
  • Authorization: Bearer {token}
  • Accept-Encoding: gzip (optional, for compressed responses)

8) Audit Files

Both procedures generate JSON audit files attached to the Remote Control record:

  • Daily Sync: microcom_readings_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.json with upsert statistics
  • Get Devices: microcom_stations_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.json with station configurations
